description: Source file defining functions and types for managing channel setup status, selection, and prompts in the openclaw project. It includes functions for collecting channel statuses, noting statuses, generating primer messages, resolving default channels, and creating selection contributions.

methods.name: buildChannelSetupSelectionContribution
methods.description: Constructs a channel setup selection contribution object with specified parameters.

methods.name: collectChannelStatus
methods.description: Gathers the status of all channels, including installed plugins, catalog entries, and chat channels, returning a summary object.

methods.name: noteChannelStatus
methods.description: Displays the current status lines of channels using a prompter.

methods.name: noteChannelPrimer
methods.description: Notes instructions and information about channels, including security and docs links, via a prompter.

methods.name: resolveQuickstartDefault
methods.description: Determines the default channel for quickstart based on the highest quickstart score.

methods.name: resolveChannelSelectionNoteLines
methods.description: Generates note lines for selected channels, describing their setup status.

methods.name: resolveChannelSetupSelectionContributions
methods.description: Creates selection contribution objects for channels, including hints and labels.
